lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: You called for me?
Yep.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: No matter what task you assign to me,

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I will complete them as quickly and precisely as I can.
Oh, I just wanted to say hi.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Say hi?
... Delta suddenly doesn't know what to reply.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Hi, Scout!

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Sorry,

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: please allow me to start over.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Hello,

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I'm Delta from the Scouts,

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: manufactured by Elysion. I'm designed

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: to provoke our enemies and defend allies by setting up the Decoy Hologram.
You can loosen up. No need to be so serious.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Besides, when attacked, I can use my special

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Ah,

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I apologize if I failed to say hi properly.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: May I first consult my teammate about it?
Sure.
It looks like Delta is really going to ask her squadmates for advice...

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I'm back.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Commander, may I know if you like training or not?
Why are you asking me this?

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: According to my squadmate,

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: the best way to break the ice during the first meeting

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: is to share your interests.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: As a soldier, I've always been interested in training, and it's also part of my daily routine.
Training is part of a soldier's duty. It's not an interest.
I'm interested in guerrilla training.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I didn't expect that.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: My squadmate's suggestion doesn't seem to work for me.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Please allow me to get back to her first.
Hold on a minute.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Sure,

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I'll be awaiting your reply.
Actually, I enjoy guerrilla training too. Well, kinda.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Oh, is that so?

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: You do seem like the type who prefers a mix of tough training routines.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: May I say that I'm suddenly overwhelmed with respect for you?

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I'd like to train with you next time at the Elysion Tower

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: if that's okay.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Don't fret.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Since both of us are professionals,

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I'd definitely select the hardest level.
... It's probably too late to stop Delta now.
